content: Geeshsha Ayyanar yess
Yey gishos, Kiristtoos Yesuusar yezitayis yhatt pirdda baaya.
Kiristtoos Yesuusa baggar nuus de7o inggiz Geeshsha Ayyana higgay, tana nagaranne yhayiqo higge aylletithapp kesseeza.

Nu nagara ashay baggar, higgay daabureez maaqqeez gishos nuna ashshodayis danda7ekkaya. Xoossay fa na7a nagaranchcho as aazisor nagaras yarshsho maaqqad garkk kiittii yeya ootheeza. Yeezii, Xoossay Kiristtoosa ashay baggar nagara, nagaranchcho as gancce pirddeeza.
Xoossay yeya ootheezay, nu asho amo koyizay garkk baazin Geeshsha Ayyanay koyizay garkk yeza nuul afa higge geesh kiitay polinttod garkke.
Fa asho amo garkk yezitay fana ufayssiz abaz qoppiza. Zin geeshsha Ayyana shene garkk yezitay geeshsha Ayyana baz qoppiza.
Asho qofay yhayiqo, zin ayyana bagga qopo de7onnee sarotithii.
Asho bagga qofa Xooss kantta morkkintto Xooss higges kiitinttooya kiitinttodayis danda7ooya.
Fa asho amos moodinttizitay Xooss ufayssodayis danda7ooya.
Zin Xooss Ayyanay yinttar yezikonnee yinttan mooddiko, yi Ayyana shener yezapp attin asho amos moodinttenna. Kiristtoosa Ayyanay baa oonkka Kiristtoosa baz baaya.
Zin Kiristtoosa yinttar yeziko, yi ashay nagara baggar yhayqqeeza. Zin yi ayyanay xillotithi baggar de7o yeza.
Zin Yesuusana yhayiqopp dentheez Xooss Ayyanay yinttar yeziko, Kiristtoosa yhayiqopp dentheez Xoossay, yinttar yez fa Geeshsha Ayyanayir yhayqqiz yi ashayis de7o immada.
Yikkee, ta ishuntho, nuul aco yeza nu asho shenes yezodayis nu ashos baaya.
Yinttii, yi asho amos yeziko yhayqqodayis yeza, zin geeshsha Ayyana wolqqar nagara ooso wodhiko yi de7or yezoda.
Xoossa Ayyanay kaalithiza ubbay Xoossis na7ita.
Nuunii, «Aabbo, Adayyo» yeegii xeegiz, Xoossis na7ita udiza geeshsha Ayyana ekkeezaypp attin maaqqii yashshar yezodayis aylle udiz ayyana ekkekkaya.
Xooss Ayyanay nu ayyanayir maaqqii nu Xoossis na7ita maaqqiza markattiza.
Nuunii e na7ita maaqqiko Xoossa laattizita; Kiristtoosar wolla yeya laattoda. Ma nuunii Kiristtoosar meto ekkiko ezar wolla e bonchcha shaakinttoda.
Ye7od bonchcho
Nuunii yhatt waayinttiza waaya, tiinapp nuus benttod bonchchayir wolihelthi be7adar, abikka aazii benttoza ta qoppiza.
Medhetithii ubbitay Xooss na7itay qonciitha gaame laamothar naagiza.
Medhetithii ubbitay cere bazis moodintteeza; yeykka, medhetithii dooror baazin ufayssis moodinttod garkk ootheez Xooss shener haneeza.
Medhetithay fa ommar dhabisiza aylletithipp wozinttii, Xooss na7itayir wolla bonchcho wozo shaakinttoda.
Medhetithay ubbay yhanno hellodayis iqithii aykkeez maachch garkk oolerannee metor yezana nu eriza.
Ma medhetith aadda baazin Geesha Ayyana bayra imota garkk ekkeez nuunii, nu ubbas nu ashayis wozo maaqqeez Xooss na7ita maaqqad ufayss naagttar nu ashayir oolliza.
Yha ufayssayir nuunii paxeeza. Zin nuunii ufayss oothizabazay benttiz maaqqiko yeya oonii ufayss udee?
Zin nu be7ekka baz demmada gi ufayssar naagiko yeya danda7ar naagiza.
Yey garkk Geesha Ayyanay nu daaburssa maaddiza. Nuunii Xoossa wayizii woossodayis beezizako erooya, zin Ayyanay fa ubbas, asii ododayis danda7inttoowa qaalar nuus gaanatiza.
Ma as wozina eriza Xoossay, Geesha Ayyana qofay abizako eriza. Geesha Ayyanay Xooss shenay garkk geeshshitayis gaanatiza.
Xoossa qadhdhizitaysinnee e shenay garkk xeegintteezitayis Xoossay ubba baz lo77os oothizana nu eriza.
Xoossay tiinattii ereezita fa Na7a aazod garkkera na7aykka gaame ishitay ammanizitay gancce bayra maaqqad garkk unttan dummassii gaddeeza.
Xoossay tiinattii qoppii gaddeezita xeegeeza; xeegeezita xilliseeza; xilliseezita ma bonchcheeza.
Xooss siiqo
Yeezin, nu yha ubbayis waagodee? Xoossay nu bagga maaqqiko nuuri oonoo eqinttoday?
E hara attozin, fa na7ayis qadhdhekazar, nu gishos aathii inggeeza. Yeezin, fa gazza na7a nuus aathii inggeezay wayizii ubba baz cer inggaamo?
Xoossii dooreezita mootoday oonoo? Xillisizay Xoosse yeezin pirddoday oonoo?
Yhayqqeezay yhayiqoppekka denddii Xooss ushachcha betteez, Kiristtoos Yesuusa, E nuus gaanatiza.
Yikkee, nuna Kiristtoosa siiqopp shaakkoday oonoo? Metone woy waayenee woy bayi7ithonee woy nayenee woy kallotithonee woy yashshanee woy olanee?
Geesha Maxaafayid,
ginttinttii xaafintteezay garkk maaqqeeza.
Zin nu yha ubbayid nuna qadhdheez Kiristtoosar gamiz ubbitaypp aadhiza.
Yey gishos, yhayiqo maaqqin yess maaqqin kiitanchchita maaqqin moddizita maaqqin yhatt yezana maaqqin tiinapp ye7oda maaqqin wolqqamita maaqqin,
Dhoqekka maaqqin ziqqekka maaqqin aba medhetithi maaqqin nu Goda, Kiristtoosa Yesuusar yeza Xooss siiqayipp nuna shaakkodayis danda7oozana taanii eriza.
